verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jules lets users review and approve plans, diffs, and PRs for individual coding tasks. It also offers an API for building custom workflows. Nothing documents versioning, review history, or rollback of the automations themselves. Task-output review and git-based PRs are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not a capability to manage automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
